text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Crazy... I'm going to a movie with my
friends,
right? But it has all this weird
stuff—the seats
shake and move, and
water sprays on you...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I've been to that theater once since
coming to
Tokyo. I went out of my mind.
I couldn't help
yelling out, like "Aaagh!
Whoa-whoa-whoa!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I mean, the seats move so much I almost
flew off!
And who wouldn't scream if
someone splashed
'em with water?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
But I guess I might've been annoying the
people
around me... Hmmm... I'll just
have to hold my
breath when I watch,
huh?
